The Market

Fresh listings from farmers and suppliers. Use search or a category to narrow it down, then contact the seller directly to agree price, quantity and delivery.

How listings work in this version — please read

The market opens empty for real listings. There are no pre-filled sellers, prices, or sales shown here. If you add a listing using the Sell form below, it appears in this Market in this browser session, on this device only — it is not saved to a server, there is no account or online payment in this version, and it will be gone when you close or reload the page. Buyers contact the seller directly on the phone / WhatsApp number shown on the listing to agree price, quantity, and delivery, and pay the seller directly.

Materials a farm needs

The inputs most farms buy every season. Look for them in the Market, or post them on the I Need board and let suppliers come to you.

  • 🌱
    Seeds & saplingsCertified seed for the season, vegetable seedlings, fruit grafts and fodder seed.
  • 🧪
    Fertiliser & soil careOrganic manure, compost, urea, DAP, potash and micronutrients — matched to a soil test where possible.
  • 💧
    IrrigationDrip lines, sprinklers, pipes, motors and pumps, plus repair parts before the season starts.
  • 🛠️
    Tools & machineryHand tools, sprayers, weeders, and tractor or harvester hire for peak days.
  • 🐄
    Feed & livestock careCattle and poultry feed, mineral mixture, and basic veterinary supplies.
  • 📦
    Packing & transportCrates, bags, boxes and local transport to the mandi, town or buyer’s door.

Orders — how buying works here

Farms to Plate connects you directly. There is no middleman and no payment taken on this page — you agree everything with the seller, then pay them your way.

1Find it

Search the Market or tap a category to find produce and materials near you.

2Enquire

Tap “Add to my enquiries” on a listing, or call the seller on the number shown.

3Agree directly

Confirm quantity, final price, and collection or delivery — farmer to buyer, plainly.

4Collect & pay

Check the produce, then pay the seller directly. Keep a note of what you agreed.

Farmer’s Guide

Simple, practical steps for selling well and buying safely — written in plain words.

For farmers selling

List on the day of harvest, show the real quantity and price, and answer calls quickly. A clear photo-ready name — crop, variety, quantity — gets more calls than a vague one.

For buyers

Call before you travel. Confirm the quantity is still available, agree the price per unit, and check quality when you collect. Pay only the seller you spoke to.

For farms buying inputs

Post on I Need with quantity and date. Compare two or three supplier calls, check seed and fertiliser labels and expiry dates, and keep the bill.

About Farms to Plate

Farms to Plate (farmstoplate.org) is a direct farm marketplace: farmers sell what they grow, buyers buy without middlemen, and farms can source the materials they need and post their requirements in one place.
